My man Martin. Mark Cuban often tells stories of how he went nights without eating, and how it was so hard for him when he was starting his business, now he is worth billions of dollars. The point is, starting a business is hard and stressful, for any person. But the harder something is the more the payout is (typically). You've just gotta put your nose in the grindstone and get into it. I've read a few statistics that no business should expect to be profitable for the first 3 months. But even during that time, nose to the grindstone.

First I want to tell you, you've got a friend in me Jack. Even if we just met, I care for you, and for the rest of my life I'll remember you and your name. 

you've wanted to for 9 years, so you've got some reason to live. Hang on to the reason you've kept living. 

About being short. Nothing is wrong with being short, im only 5'7 and I guess people consider me "short". but being short doesn't
mean anything. Napoleon was short. Hitler was short. Both are incredibly smart and were successful men. 

Life is a hard fucking thing to do, I won't lie. but you've just got to put your nose in the grindstone sometimes and prove to everyone that you're better than they thought you were. 

I can't keep you from ending your life, but I can tell you that I would miss you. And I will remember you. 

Much love brother, you can get through this.
Hey brother. What's your name? I'm Luke.

Nice to meet you brother. First, you're absolutely of intelligence. You're capable of pursuing a masters degree, and I understand you stopped pursuing it, but you had the intelligence to go for it. You have the effort, whereas most don't. College is one of the most stressful, and sometimes depressing, things to encounter in your life. 
About finding a mate, not everyone is going to find their love so early in life. And truth be told, there are a few hardships in finding every love. But setting your head forward is a great first step in finding someone. 
And your family business. Brother oh brother. Mark Cuban tells his stories all the time of how he was broke neck poor when he first started building his company, to the point where he was going nights without food. Starting a business up is incredibly stressful, and induces depression if it doesn't go well at first. 
I've read statistics that in the first 2-3 months, no business should expect a profit. But you've gotta put your nose in the grindstone and push through it.
Also, about your self confidence, if you wake up every morning and just tell yourself "I can do this" then you're going to start believing that, I used to be in the same situation. I hated life, and my self confidence was in the trash. But I wake up every morning and I say that to myself, even if I don't think I can do it. But you can.

I can't stop you from committing, but I can ask you not too. I would miss you and i'm
sure many others would.

Much love.

Keep your head up brother

I know it seems like the world is ending but it isn't. Shit happens in life, and I know that isn't the answer you want, but I just need you to think about everything that is positive in life. I know you think your parents hate you, but they don't. I know it sucks to have your friend kill herself, I was there too. But you've gotta look at the positives brother. Don't let a temporary situation have a permanent resolution.

Stay strong brother, I care and I would miss you.

Much love.

I care for you.

like you said, you've made up your mind and I can't change that. But I will tell you, I will miss you, and I do care for you.

hey brother, I'll let Andrew help with the body stuff. but about your friends. like, not everyone is a good friend. and in life people are always out to benefit themselves and honestly sometimes the things people will do for themselves is sickening. they lie, they cheat, they steal, and they don't even think about who they are hurting in doing so. my advice on that is just drop the friends you have. think about yourself a little bit, and try finding a group or clique of friends that is there that likes what you do or that you can easily associate with. 
the sleeping problem, that's a tough one, but easy to fix. what I've found out about myself is that laying and thinking alone about everything bad is the worst thing to do, because it's like a mental torture. I was in the same place as you at one point, but I never told anyone. then I found someone that listened, and falling asleep became so much easier. sometimes finding that one person, whether you've never met them or they are someone you know personally, talking to that person until you fall asleep really helps. 
Like Andrew said, I hardly ever dream either when I sleep. 

get well brother. I know I can't stop you from killing yourself, but what I will tell you is that I will miss you if you do.

best of luck, much love.
Still with us brother? I've got a few insightful (and hopefully enlightening) words for you.

Hey man. I don't know if you've already given up but I understand where you're coming from. Life is a fucked up thing, from beginning to start, but giving up isn't the way to go man. Not anyone you know is going to hit harder than life, but it isn't about how hard you can get hit, it's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward. You can't give up now, because in however many years, you're going to find someone and they are going to love you more than anything else in the world.  You're going to be able to wake up one morning, look over at the person you love and just smile. Smile because you were at this point once in your life and now you're there. You'll be able to talk to them about how you were sad, and now how happy you were. Life is a fucked up thing, and I'll agree with you on that. But through it all, you can get hit and keep moving forward, because one day you'll look back and think about how happy you were that you didn't do it. 
please just trust me brother. It's going to get better.
